places.name: Mahabaleshwara Temple
places.description: The Atmalinga makes this one of the most theologically significant Shiva shrines in South India.
places.bestTime: October to February; Mahashivaratri for the grand festival

places.name: Om Beach
places.description: The unique Om-shaped coastline and lively but not overcrowded beach scene define Gokarna's character.
places.bestTime: October to March for calm seas and sunny skies

places.name: Kudle Beach
places.description: The best combination of safe swimming, chilled beach cafés, and a reliable sunset view.

places.name: Gokarna Main Beach (Town Beach)
places.description: A living religious beach where pilgrimage rituals play out at the edge of the Arabian Sea daily.
places.mapsSearch: Gokarna Main Beach Town Beach Karnataka
places.bestTime: Dawn for bathing rituals; Mahashivaratri for the chariot festival

places.name: Half Moon Beach
places.description: The most intimate and picturesque of Gokarna's secluded cove beaches.
places.bestTime: November to February; arrive early morning before day-boats arrive

places.name: Paradise Beach
places.description: The most secluded, unspoilt beach on the Gokarna coast — the effort to reach it is part of the appeal.
places.bestTime: October to February; avoid monsoon completely

places.name: Mirjan Fort
places.description: A genuinely haunting, unmanicured fort ruin surrounded by tropical river jungle with almost no tourists.
places.bestTime: October to February; post-monsoon when the walls are draped in green

places.name: Bhadrakali Temple
places.description: The dramatic clifftop position and the goddess temple add a complementary dimension to the Shiva pilgrimage.

places.name: Car Street (Cart Street), Gokarna
places.description: A rare surviving example of a living temple-town streetscape unchanged in its essential character for centuries.
places.bestTime: Mahashivaratri chariot festival; otherwise any morning

places.name: Om Beach Cliff Trek to Half Moon
places.description: The only way to see Gokarna's coastline as a complete panoramic picture and access the secluded southern beaches.
places.mapsSearch: Om Beach to Paradise Beach Trek Gokarna Karnataka
places.bestTime: October to February; start before 8 am to avoid heat

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
